TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleRequest and sends it to ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules. ABKOR001Impl.validateMassivePricingRuleRequest rejects a null request or null details list with ABKO10010420, rejects fewer than two ACT details with ABKO10010420, rejects duplicated or null ACT identifiers with ABKO10010421, and rejects any null detail, null entityType or null id with ABKO10010422. For each generated rule, PricingRuleValidator.validatePost validates effectiveDate.startDate and effectiveDate.endDate and throws ABKO10000404 when the end date is before the start date. 2. Decisions and branches: ABKOR001Impl.buildMassivePricingRules keeps non-ACT and non-CUS details as common details, then creates one PricingRuleDTO per ACT detail by copying the request without details and adding the copied ACT detail to the copied common details. validatePostPricingRule checks duplicate candidates and can trigger ABKO10010401, ABKO10010402 or ABKO10010415 during duplicate validation, and PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues can throw ABKO10010004 when a detail query is missing, returns no value or raises NoResultException. After obtaining customAttributeId, batchId and auditId, executePostMassivePricingRules adds a CUS detail with value MASIVA to each generated rule and persists it; insertMassiveCustomAttribute throws ABKO00000010 when the insert result is 0. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() invokes ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules. In ABKOR001Impl.executePostMassivePricingRules, the method validates the massive request, builds the per-ACT pricingRules list, validates each generated rule through validatePostPricingRule, resolves the audit user with getUserId, obtains custom attribute and audit identifiers from PricingRuleRepository.getNextCustomAttributeId, getNextCustomAttributeBatchId and getNextId, inserts the massive custom attribute with insertAudit and insertMassiveCustomAttribute, and persists each generated rule with persistNewPricingRule, which inserts the pricing rule through PricingRuleMapper.mapToInsert and PricingRuleRepository.insertPricingRule and insertDetails. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: validateMassivePricingRuleRequest throws ABKO10010420 when pricingRuleDTO or pricingRuleDTO.getDetails() is null and also when fewer than two ACT details are found, throws ABKO10010421 when an ACT detail id is null or duplicated, and throws ABKO10010422 when any detail, detail entityType or detail id is null. PricingRuleValidator.validatePost throws ABKO10000404 when effectiveDate.endDate is before effectiveDate.startDate. UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists throws ABKO10010401 when duplicate validation reaches that method, PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handleVariableExactMatch throws ABKO10010402 when it detects an existing variable rule with different fee, UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPaymentMethodOverlap throws ABKO10010415 when it detects payment method overlap, PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when the detail lookup query is missing, blank or unresolved, and PricingRuleRepository.insertMassiveCustomAttribute throws ABKO00000010 when the insert returns 0. ABKOR001Impl.executePostMassivePricingRules catches PricingRuleException, adds the advice with addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()), and returns Collections.emptyList(). After execute() regains control, assignSeverityError sets Severity.EWR when getAdviceList() is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() always calls setPricingrulesresponse(pricingRules) with the list returned by ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules; on success it contains one persisted PricingRuleDTO per ACT detail, and on PricingRuleException it is Collections.emptyList(). The setter addParameter("pricingRulesResponse", field) runs without guards, so the output parameter is assigned even when the returned list is empty.
